# netbox_power_feeds (Data Source)

Lists power_feed objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_power_feeds" "test" {
  filters = [
    { name = "name", value = "test-power_feed" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, name, name__empty, name__ic, name__ie, name__iew, name__iregex, name__isw, name__n, name__nic, name__nie, name__niew, name__nisw, name__regex, owner_id, owner_id__n, power_panel_id, power_panel_id__n, rack_id, rack_id__n, status, status__empty, status__ic, status__ie, status__iew, status__iregex, status__isw, status__n, status__nic, status__nie, status__niew, status__nisw, status__regex, tag, tag__any, tag__n, type, type__empty, type__ic, type__ie, type__iew, type__iregex, type__isw, type__n, type__nic, type__nie, type__niew, type__nisw, type__regex. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. Custom fields filter as cf_<field name>, e.g. cf_tier, with the field's own filter logic: loose is a case-insensitive substring match, exact an exact match. NetBox ignores names it has no custom field for, and such an entry does not narrow the result. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.
- `name_regex` (String) Go regular expression the name must match. Applied after the API query, which then fetches every object matching the filters; limit applies to the matches.

### Read-Only

- `power_feeds` (Attributes List) The matching power_feeds. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--power_feeds))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--power_feeds"></a>
### Nested Schema for `power_feeds`

Read-Only:

- `amperage` (Number) Amperage of the feed.
- `comments` (String)
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `mark_connected` (Boolean) Treat the feed as connected even without a cable.
- `max_percent_utilization` (Number, Deprecated) Deprecated alias of max_utilization_percent.
- `max_utilization_percent` (Number) Maximum permitted draw as a percentage.
- `name` (String)
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `phase` (String) Phase type. One of: single-phase, three-phase.
- `power_panel_id` (Number) Id of the power panel the feed starts at.
- `rack_id` (Number) Id of the rack the feed serves.
- `status` (String) Operational status. One of: offline, active, planned, failed.
- `supply` (String) Supply type. One of: ac, dc.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `type` (String) Whether the feed is the primary or the redundant one. One of: primary, redundant.
- `url` (String)
- `voltage` (Number) Voltage of the feed.
